title: Compaction Drift — The Harness Keeps What the Agent Needs to Continue. Your Rule Isn't It.
tagline: OpenAI's Agents API went to public beta on 10 September 2026 and now compacts your session for you, preserving information the agent needs to continue. A standing rule is not that. Lay out a long session and watch which of your rules is still in context at the moment the agent is about to break it.
description: Simulate a long agent session: see which of your rules survive repeated context compaction, and which are gone by the time they matter.
